    class Messages(Resource):
    """Send messages and read receipts.

    Every ``send_*`` returns :class:`MessageResponse` (use ``.message_id``).
    ``reply_to`` quotes a message; ``biz_opaque_callback_data`` is echoed back
    in status webhooks.
    """

    # --- generic -----------------------------------------------------------

    def send(
        self,
        to: str,
        type: str,
        content: Any,
        *,
        recipient_type: RecipientType = "individual",
        reply_to: str | None = None,
        biz_opaque_callback_data: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> MessageResponse:
        """Send any message type with a raw/built content payload."""
        kw = dict(
            recipient_type=recipient_type,
            reply_to=reply_to,
            biz_opaque_callback_data=biz_opaque_callback_data,
        )
        return self._req(_spec(self._pnid(phone_number_id), _common(to, type, content, kw)))

    def send_raw(
        self, payload: dict[str, Any], *, phone_number_id: str | None = None
    ) -> MessageResponse:
        """Send a fully-formed JSON payload (escape hatch)."""
        body = {"messaging_product": "whatsapp", **payload}
        return self._req(_spec(self._pnid(phone_number_id), clean_body(body)))

    # --- text --------------------------------------------------------------

    def send_text(
        self,
        to: str,
        body: str,
        *,
        preview_url: bool = False,
        recipient_type: RecipientType = "individual",
        reply_to: str | None = None,
        biz_opaque_callback_data: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> MessageResponse:
        return self.send(
            to,
            "text",
            Text(body, preview_url=preview_url),
            recipient_type=recipient_type,
            reply_to=reply_to,
            biz_opaque_callback_data=biz_opaque_callback_data,
            phone_number_id=phone_number_id,
        )

    # --- media -------------------------------------------------------------

    def _send_media(
        self,
        type_: str,
        to: str,
        kw: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> MessageResponse:
        kw_media = {k: kw.pop(k) for k in ("media_id", "link", "caption", "filename") if k in kw}
        return self.send(to, type_, Media(**kw_media), **kw)

    def send_image(
        self,
        to: str,
        *,
        media_id: str | None = None,
        link: str | None = None,
        caption: str | None = None,
        recipient_type: RecipientType = "individual",
        reply_to: str | None = None,
        biz_opaque_callback_data: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> MessageResponse:
        return self._send_media(
            "image",
            to,
            dict(
                media_id=media_id,
                link=link,
                caption=caption,
                recipient_type=recipient_type,
                reply_to=reply_to,
                biz_opaque_callback_data=biz_opaque_callback_data,
                phone_number_id=phone_number_id,
            ),
        )

    def send_audio(
        self,
        to: str,
        *,
        media_id: str | None = None,
        link: str | None = None,
        recipient_type: RecipientType = "individual",
        reply_to: str | None = None,
        biz_opaque_callback_data: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> MessageResponse:
        return self._send_media(
            "audio",
            to,
            dict(
                media_id=media_id,
                link=link,
                recipient_type=recipient_type,
                reply_to=reply_to,
                biz_opaque_callback_data=biz_opaque_callback_data,
                phone_number_id=phone_number_id,
            ),
        )

    def send_video(
        self,
        to: str,
        *,
        media_id: str | None = None,
        link: str | None = None,
        caption: str | None = None,
        recipient_type: RecipientType = "individual",
        reply_to: str | None = None,
        biz_opaque_callback_data: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> MessageResponse:
        return self._send_media(
            "video",
            to,
            dict(
                media_id=media_id,
                link=link,
                caption=caption,
                recipient_type=recipient_type,
                reply_to=reply_to,
                biz_opaque_callback_data=biz_opaque_callback_data,
                phone_number_id=phone_number_id,
            ),
        )

    def send_document(
        self,
        to: str,
        *,
        media_id: str | None = None,
        link: str | None = None,
        caption: str | None = None,
        filename: str | None = None,
        recipient_type: RecipientType = "individual",
        reply_to: str | None = None,
        biz_opaque_callback_data: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> MessageResponse:
        return self._send_media(
            "document",
            to,
            dict(
                media_id=media_id,
                link=link,
                caption=caption,
                filename=filename,
                recipient_type=recipient_type,
                reply_to=reply_to,
                biz_opaque_callback_data=biz_opaque_callback_data,
                phone_number_id=phone_number_id,
            ),
        )

    def send_sticker(
        self,
        to: str,
        *,
        media_id: str | None = None,
        link: str | None = None,
        recipient_type: RecipientType = "individual",
        reply_to: str | None = None,
        biz_opaque_callback_data: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> MessageResponse:
        return self._send_media(
            "sticker",
            to,
            dict(
                media_id=media_id,
                link=link,
                recipient_type=recipient_type,
                reply_to=reply_to,
                biz_opaque_callback_data=biz_opaque_callback_data,
                phone_number_id=phone_number_id,
            ),
        )

    # --- other content types ------------------------------------------------

    def send_location(
        self,
        to: str,
        *,
        latitude: float,
        longitude: float,
        name: str | None = None,
        address: str | None = None,
        recipient_type: RecipientType = "individual",
        reply_to: str | None = None,
        biz_opaque_callback_data: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> MessageResponse:
        content = clean_body(
            {"latitude": latitude, "longitude": longitude, "name": name, "address": address}
        )
        return self.send(
            to,
            "location",
            content,
            recipient_type=recipient_type,
            reply_to=reply_to,
            biz_opaque_callback_data=biz_opaque_callback_data,
            phone_number_id=phone_number_id,
        )

    def send_contacts(
        self,
        to: str,
        contacts: list[dict[str, Any] | Payload],
        *,
        recipient_type: RecipientType = "individual",
        reply_to: str | None = None,
        biz_opaque_callback_data: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> MessageResponse:
        return self.send(
            to,
            "contacts",
            [as_dict(c) for c in contacts],
            recipient_type=recipient_type,
            reply_to=reply_to,
            biz_opaque_callback_data=biz_opaque_callback_data,
            phone_number_id=phone_number_id,
        )

    def send_reaction(
        self,
        to: str,
        *,
        message_id: str,
        emoji: str,
        recipient_type: RecipientType = "individual",
        biz_opaque_callback_data: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> MessageResponse:
        return self.send(
            to,
            "reaction",
            {"message_id": message_id, "emoji": emoji},
            recipient_type=recipient_type,
            biz_opaque_callback_data=biz_opaque_callback_data,
            phone_number_id=phone_number_id,
        )

    def send_interactive(
        self,
        to: str,
        interactive: dict[str, Any] | Payload,
        *,
        recipient_type: RecipientType = "individual",
        reply_to: str | None = None,
        biz_opaque_callback_data: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> MessageResponse:
        """Send any interactive message — pass a builder (``Buttons``,
        ``ListMessage``, ``FlowMessage``…) or a raw dict."""
        return self.send(
            to,
            "interactive",
            as_dict(interactive),
            recipient_type=recipient_type,
            reply_to=reply_to,
            biz_opaque_callback_data=biz_opaque_callback_data,
            phone_number_id=phone_number_id,
        )

    def send_template(
        self,
        to: str,
        template: dict[str, Any] | Payload,
        *,
        recipient_type: RecipientType = "individual",
        reply_to: str | None = None,
        biz_opaque_callback_data: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> MessageResponse:
        return self.send(
            to,
            "template",
            as_dict(template),
            recipient_type=recipient_type,
            reply_to=reply_to,
            biz_opaque_callback_data=biz_opaque_callback_data,
            phone_number_id=phone_number_id,
        )

    # --- receipts / indicators ----------------------------------------------

    def mark_read(
        self,
        message_id: str,
        *,
        typing: bool = False,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Mark a message read; optionally show a typing indicator."""
        body = clean_body(
            {
                "messaging_product": "whatsapp",
                "status": "read",
                "message_id": message_id,
                "typing_indicator": {"type": "text"} if typing else None,
            }
        )
        spec = ApiRequest("POST", f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/messages", json=body)
        return self._req(spec)

    def mark_read(
    self,
    message_id: str,
    *,
    typing: bool = False,
    phone_number_id: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Mark a message read; optionally show a typing indicator."""
    body = clean_body(
        {
            "messaging_product": "whatsapp",
            "status": "read",
            "message_id": message_id,
            "typing_indicator": {"type": "text"} if typing else None,
        }
    )
    spec = ApiRequest("POST", f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/messages", json=body)
    return self._req(spec)

    class Media(Resource):
    """``/{phone-number-id}/media`` + ``/{media-id}`` operations."""

    def upload(
        self,
        file: Any,
        *,
        mime_type: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> MediaUploadResult:
        """Upload media for use in messages.

        ``file`` accepts a path, ``bytes``, or an open binary file.
        Returns an object with a media ``id`` (valid ~30 days).
        """
        return self._req(_upload_spec(self._pnid(phone_number_id), file, mime_type))

    def get(self, media_id: str, *, phone_number_id: str | None = None) -> MediaInfo:
        """Retrieve a media object — includes a temporary download ``url``."""
        return self._req(_info_spec(media_id, phone_number_id))

    def delete(self, media_id: str, *, phone_number_id: str | None = None) -> bool:
        body = self._req(_delete_spec(media_id, phone_number_id))
        return bool(body.get("success"))

    def download(
        self,
        media: str | MediaInfo,
        dest: str | Path | None = None,
        *,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> bytes | Path:
        """Download media bytes.

        ``media`` may be a media ID, a ``MediaInfo``, or a raw download URL.
        When ``dest`` is given the file is written and its path returned.
        """
        url: str | None
        if isinstance(media, MediaInfo):
            url = media.url
        elif media.startswith("http"):
            url = media
        else:
            url = self.get(media, phone_number_id=phone_number_id).url
        if not url:
            raise ValueError("no download URL available for this media")
        data = self._c._download(url)
        if dest is not None:
            path = Path(dest)
            path.write_bytes(data)
            return path
        return data

    def resumable_upload(
        self,
        file: Any,
        *,
        mime_type: str | None = None,
        app_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> str:
        """Resumable Upload API → an asset *handle* (``h:…``).

        Required for template header media and profile pictures.
        ``app_id`` defaults to the client's ``app_id``.
        """
        return self._c._resumable_upload(file, mime_type=mime_type, app_id=app_id)

    class Templates(Resource):
    """Create, list, edit, delete and migrate message templates."""

    def list(
        self,
        *,
        fields: Sequence[str] | str | None = None,
        status: str | None = None,
        category: str | None = None,
        content: str | None = None,
        language: str | None = None,
        name: str | None = None,
        quality_score: str | None = None,
        limit: int | None = None,
        after: str | None = None,
        before: str | None = None,
        waba_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> Any:
        """Iterate templates (auto-paginates)."""
        spec = ApiRequest(
            "GET",
            f"{self._waba(waba_id)}/message_templates",
            params=_list_params(
                dict(
                    fields=fields,
                    status=status,
                    category=category,
                    content=content,
                    language=language,
                    name=name,
                    quality_score=quality_score,
                    limit=limit,
                    after=after,
                    before=before,
                )
            ),
        )
        return self._page(spec, Template.model_validate)

    def get(self, template_id: str, *, fields: Sequence[str] | str | None = None) -> Template:
        spec = ApiRequest(
            "GET",
            template_id,
            params=clean_params({"fields": merge_fields(fields)}),
            into=Template.model_validate,
        )
        return self._req(spec)

    def create(
        self,
        *,
        name: str,
        language: str,
        category: str,
        components: Sequence[dict[str, Any]],
        parameter_format: str | None = None,
        allow_category_change: bool | None = None,
        cta_url_link_tracking_opted_out: bool | None = None,
        message_send_ttl_seconds: int | None = None,
        sub_category: str | None = None,
        display_format: str | None = None,
        library_template_name: str | None = None,
        library_template_body_inputs: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        library_template_button_inputs: Sequence[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
        is_primary_device_delivery_only: bool | None = None,
        send_type: str | None = None,
        waba_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> TemplateCreated:
        body = _create_body(
            dict(
                name=name,
                language=language,
                category=category,
                components=components,
                parameter_format=parameter_format,
                allow_category_change=allow_category_change,
                cta_url_link_tracking_opted_out=cta_url_link_tracking_opted_out,
                message_send_ttl_seconds=message_send_ttl_seconds,
                sub_category=sub_category,
                display_format=display_format,
                library_template_name=library_template_name,
                library_template_body_inputs=library_template_body_inputs,
                library_template_button_inputs=library_template_button_inputs,
                is_primary_device_delivery_only=is_primary_device_delivery_only,
                send_type=send_type,
            )
        )
        spec = ApiRequest(
            "POST",
            f"{self._waba(waba_id)}/message_templates",
            json=body,
            into=TemplateCreated.model_validate,
        )
        return self._req(spec)

    def edit(
        self,
        template_id: str,
        *,
        components: Sequence[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
        category: str | None = None,
        parameter_format: str | None = None,
        allow_category_change: bool | None = None,
        cta_url_link_tracking_opted_out: bool | None = None,
        message_send_ttl_seconds: int | None = None,
        sub_category: str | None = None,
        display_format: str | None = None,
        is_primary_device_delivery_only: bool | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        body = _create_body(
            dict(
                components=components,
                category=category,
                parameter_format=parameter_format,
                allow_category_change=allow_category_change,
                cta_url_link_tracking_opted_out=cta_url_link_tracking_opted_out,
                message_send_ttl_seconds=message_send_ttl_seconds,
                sub_category=sub_category,
                display_format=display_format,
                is_primary_device_delivery_only=is_primary_device_delivery_only,
            )
        )
        return self._req(ApiRequest("POST", template_id, json=body))

    def delete(
        self,
        *,
        name: str | None = None,
        hsm_id: str | None = None,
        hsm_ids: Sequence[str] | None = None,
        waba_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Delete by ``name`` (all languages), ``name`` + ``hsm_id`` (one
        language), or ``hsm_ids`` (up to 100 templates)."""

    class PhoneNumbers(Resource):
    """WABA phone numbers + per-number registration and settings."""

    def list(
        self,
        *,
        fields: Sequence[str] | str | None = None,
        filtering: Sequence[dict[str, Any]] | str | None = None,
        sort: str | None = None,
        limit: int | None = None,
        after: str | None = None,
        before: str | None = None,
        waba_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> Any:
        spec = ApiRequest(
            "GET",
            f"{self._waba(waba_id)}/phone_numbers",
            params=clean_params(
                dict(
                    fields=merge_fields(fields),
                    filtering=filtering,
                    sort=sort,
                    limit=limit,
                    after=after,
                    before=before,
                )
            ),
        )
        return self._page(spec, PhoneNumber.model_validate)

    def add(
        self,
        *,
        cc: str,
        phone_number: str,
        verified_name: str,
        migrate_phone_number: bool | None = None,
        preverified_id: str | None = None,
        waba_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Add a phone number to the WABA (E.164 digits, no ``+``)."""
        body = clean_body(
            dict(
                cc=cc,
                phone_number=phone_number,
                verified_name=verified_name,
                migrate_phone_number=migrate_phone_number,
                preverified_id=preverified_id,
            )
        )
        return self._req(ApiRequest("POST", f"{self._waba(waba_id)}/phone_numbers", json=body))

    def get(
        self,
        *,
        fields: Sequence[str] | str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> PhoneNumberInfo:
        spec = ApiRequest(
            "GET",
            self._pnid(phone_number_id),
            params=clean_params({"fields": merge_fields(fields)}),
            into=PhoneNumberInfo.model_validate,
        )
        return self._req(spec)

    def update(self, *, phone_number_id: str | None = None, **fields: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Update number config: ``webhook_url``, ``webhook_configuration``,
        ``pin``, ``new_display_name``, ``username``, ``search_visibility``,
        ``connection_status``, ``whatsapp_business_api_data``."""
        return self._req(ApiRequest("POST", self._pnid(phone_number_id), json=clean_body(fields)))

    def request_code(
        self,
        *,
        code_method: CodeMethod = "SMS",
        language: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        body = clean_body({"code_method": code_method, "language": language})
        return self._req(
            ApiRequest("POST", f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/request_code", json=body)
        )

    def verify_code(self, code: str, *, phone_number_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._req(
            ApiRequest("POST", f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/verify_code", json={"code": code})
        )

    def register(
        self,
        *,
        pin: str,
        data_localization_region: str | None = None,
        backup: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Register the number after verification. ``pin`` = 6-digit 2FA PIN."""
        return self._req(
            ApiRequest(
                "POST",
                f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/register",
                json=_register_body(pin, data_localization_region, backup),
            )
        )

    def deregister(self, *, phone_number_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._req(ApiRequest("POST", f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/deregister", json={}))

    def get_settings(
        self,
        *,
        include_sip_credentials: bool | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._req(
            ApiRequest(
                "GET",
                f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/settings",
                params=clean_params({"include_sip_credentials": include_sip_credentials}),
            )
        )

    def update_settings(
        self,
        *,
        calling: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        user_identity_change: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        payload_encryption: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        storage_configuration: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Update one settings group per call."""
        body = clean_body(
            dict(
                calling=calling,
                user_identity_change=user_identity_change,
                payload_encryption=payload_encryption,
                storage_configuration=storage_configuration,
            )
        )
        if not body:
            raise ValueError("at least one settings group is required")
        return self._req(ApiRequest("POST", f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/settings", json=body))

    def get_official_status(
        self, *, phone_number_id: str | None = None, fields: Sequence[str] | str | None = None
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._req(
            ApiRequest(
                "GET",
                f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/official_business_account",
                params=clean_params({"fields": merge_fields(fields)}),
            )
        )

    def update_official_status(self, *, phone_number_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._req(
            ApiRequest("POST", f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/official_business_account", json={})
        )

    class Calls(Resource):
    """Initiate and manage WhatsApp VoIP calls (WebRTC SDP)."""

    def check_permissions(
        self, user_wa_id: str, *, phone_number_id: str | None = None
    ) -> CallPermission:
        """Whether you may call ``user_wa_id`` and which actions are available."""
        spec = ApiRequest(
            "GET",
            f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/call_permissions",
            params=clean_params({"user_wa_id": user_wa_id}),
            into=CallPermission.model_validate,
        )
        return self._req(spec)

    def connect(
        self,
        to: str,
        sdp: str,
        *,
        biz_opaque_callback_data: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> CallResult:
        """Initiate a call — ``sdp`` is the local SDP *offer* (RFC 8866)."""
        body = _call_body(
            "connect",
            to=to,
            sdp_type="offer",
            sdp=sdp,
            biz_opaque_callback_data=biz_opaque_callback_data,
        )
        return self._req(self._spec(body, phone_number_id))

    def pre_accept(
        self, call_id: str, sdp: str, *, phone_number_id: str | None = None
    ) -> CallResult:
        return self._req(
            self._spec(
                _call_body("pre_accept", call_id=call_id, sdp_type="answer", sdp=sdp),
                phone_number_id,
            )
        )

    def accept(
        self,
        call_id: str,
        sdp: str,
        *,
        biz_opaque_callback_data: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> CallResult:
        """Accept an inbound call — ``sdp`` is the local SDP *answer*."""
        return self._req(
            self._spec(
                _call_body(
                    "accept",
                    call_id=call_id,
                    sdp_type="answer",
                    sdp=sdp,
                    biz_opaque_callback_data=biz_opaque_callback_data,
                ),
                phone_number_id,
            )
        )

    def reject(self, call_id: str, *, phone_number_id: str | None = None) -> CallResult:
        return self._req(self._spec(_call_body("reject", call_id=call_id), phone_number_id))

    def terminate(self, call_id: str, *, phone_number_id: str | None = None) -> CallResult:
        return self._req(self._spec(_call_body("terminate", call_id=call_id), phone_number_id))

    def media_update(
        self, call_id: str, sdp: str, *, phone_number_id: str | None = None
    ) -> CallResult:
        return self._req(
            self._spec(
                _call_body("media_update", call_id=call_id, sdp_type="offer", sdp=sdp),
                phone_number_id,
            )
        )

    def _spec(self, body: dict[str, Any], phone_number_id: str | None) -> ApiRequest[CallResult]:
        return ApiRequest(
            "POST",
            f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/calls",
            json=body,
            into=CallResult.model_validate,
        )

    class Groups(Resource):
    """Create and manage WhatsApp groups for the business number."""

    def list(
        self,
        *,
        limit: int | None = None,
        after: str | None = None,
        before: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> Any:
        spec = ApiRequest(
            "GET",
            f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/groups",
            params=clean_params({"limit": limit, "after": after, "before": before}),
        )
        return self._page(spec, Group.model_validate)

    def create(
        self,
        *,
        subject: str,
        description: str | None = None,
        join_approval_mode: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> GroupCreated:
        body = _group_body(
            subject=subject, description=description, join_approval_mode=join_approval_mode
        )
        spec = ApiRequest(
            "POST",
            f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/groups",
            json=body,
            into=GroupCreated.model_validate,
        )
        return self._req(spec)

    def get(self, group_id: str, *, fields: Sequence[str] | str | None = None) -> Group:
        spec = ApiRequest(
            "GET",
            group_id,
            params=clean_params({"fields": merge_fields(fields)}),
            into=Group.model_validate,
        )
        return self._req(spec)

    def update(
        self,
        group_id: str,
        *,
        subject: str | None = None,
        description: str | None = None,
        profile_picture: str | Path | bytes | None = None,
        profile_picture_file: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Update subject/description; set picture via ``profile_picture``
        (path/bytes → multipart) or a server-side ``profile_picture_file`` path."""
        if profile_picture is not None:
            import mimetypes

            name = getattr(profile_picture, "name", None) or "picture.jpg"
            if isinstance(profile_picture, (str, Path)):
                p = Path(profile_picture)
                content = p.read_bytes()
                name = p.name
            else:
                content = profile_picture
            spec = ApiRequest(
                "POST",
                group_id,
                data={"messaging_product": "whatsapp"},
                files={"file": (name, content, mimetypes.guess_type(str(name))[0] or "image/jpeg")},
            )
            return self._req(spec)
        body = _group_body(
            subject=subject, description=description, profile_picture_file=profile_picture_file
        )
        return self._req(ApiRequest("POST", group_id, json=body))

    def delete(self, group_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._req(ApiRequest("DELETE", group_id))

    # --- participants -------------------------------------------------------

    def add_participants(self, group_id: str, participants: Sequence[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Add up to 8 members per call (phone numbers or WA-IDs)."""
        body = _group_body(participants=participants)
        return self._req(ApiRequest("POST", f"{group_id}/participants", json=body))

    def remove_participants(self, group_id: str, participants: Sequence[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        body = _group_body(participants=participants)
        return self._req(ApiRequest("DELETE", f"{group_id}/participants", json=body))

    # --- invite links --------------------------------------------------------

    def create_invite_link(self, group_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._req(ApiRequest("POST", f"{group_id}/invite_link", json={}))

    def revoke_invite_link(self, group_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._req(ApiRequest("DELETE", f"{group_id}/invite_link"))

    # --- join requests --------------------------------------------------------

    def list_join_requests(self, group_id: str) -> Any:
        spec = ApiRequest("GET", f"{group_id}/join_requests")
        return self._page(spec, JoinRequest.model_validate)

    def approve_join_requests(self, group_id: str, request_ids: Sequence[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._req(
            ApiRequest(
                "POST", f"{group_id}/join_requests", json=_group_body(join_requests=request_ids)
            )
        )

    def reject_join_requests(self, group_id: str, request_ids: Sequence[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._req(
            ApiRequest(
                "DELETE", f"{group_id}/join_requests", json=_group_body(join_requests=request_ids)
            )
        )

    class Flows(Resource):
    """Create, update, publish, deprecate, and migrate WhatsApp Flows."""

    def list(
        self,
        *,
        limit: int | None = None,
        after: str | None = None,
        before: str | None = None,
        waba_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> Any:
        spec = ApiRequest(
            "GET",
            f"{self._waba(waba_id)}/flows",
            params=clean_params({"limit": limit, "after": after, "before": before}),
        )
        return self._page(spec, Flow.model_validate)

    def create(
        self,
        *,
        name: str,
        categories: Sequence[str],
        flow_json: str | dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        publish: bool | None = None,
        clone_flow_id: str | None = None,
        endpoint_uri: str | None = None,
        waba_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> FlowCreated:
        import json as _json

        if isinstance(flow_json, dict):
            flow_json = _json.dumps(flow_json)
        body = clean_body(
            dict(
                name=name,
                categories=categories,
                flow_json=flow_json,
                publish=publish,
                clone_flow_id=clone_flow_id,
                endpoint_uri=endpoint_uri,
            )
        )
        spec = ApiRequest(
            "POST", f"{self._waba(waba_id)}/flows", json=body, into=FlowCreated.model_validate
        )
        return self._req(spec)

    def get(self, flow_id: str, *, fields: Sequence[str] | str | None = None) -> Flow:
        spec = ApiRequest(
            "GET",
            flow_id,
            params=clean_params({"fields": merge_fields(fields)}),
            into=Flow.model_validate,
        )
        return self._req(spec)

    def update(
        self,
        flow_id: str,
        *,
        name: str | None = None,
        categories: Sequence[str] | None = None,
        endpoint_uri: str | None = None,
        application_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        body = clean_body(
            dict(
                name=name,
                categories=categories,
                endpoint_uri=endpoint_uri,
                application_id=application_id,
            )
        )
        return self._req(ApiRequest("POST", flow_id, json=body))

    def delete(self, flow_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Delete a DRAFT flow (published flows must be deprecated instead)."""
        return self._req(ApiRequest("DELETE", flow_id))

    def update_json(self, flow_id: str, flow_json: str | bytes | dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Upload a new ``flow.json`` (DRAFT flows only). Returns validation errors if any."""
        import json as _json

        content: bytes
        if isinstance(flow_json, dict):
            content = _json.dumps(flow_json).encode()
        elif isinstance(flow_json, str):
            content = flow_json.encode()
        else:
            content = flow_json
        spec = ApiRequest(
            "POST",
            f"{flow_id}/assets",
            data={"name": "flow.json", "asset_type": "FLOW_JSON"},
            files={"file": ("flow.json", content, "application/json")},
        )
        return self._req(spec)

    def list_assets(self, flow_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._req(ApiRequest("GET", f"{flow_id}/assets"))

    def preview(self, flow_id: str, *, invalidate: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Get a shareable web preview URL for a flow."""
        spec = ApiRequest(
            "GET",
            flow_id,
            params={"fields": f"preview.invalidate({'true' if invalidate else 'false'})"},
        )
        return self._req(spec)

    def publish(self, flow_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._req(ApiRequest("POST", f"{flow_id}/publish", json={}))

    def deprecate(self, flow_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._req(ApiRequest("POST", f"{flow_id}/deprecate", json={}))

        self,

        source_waba_id: str,
        source_flow_names: Sequence[str] | None = None,

    ) -> FlowMigrationResult:

                {"source_waba_id": source_waba_id, "source_flow_names": source_flow_names}
            ),
            into=FlowMigrationResult.model_validate,
        )
        return self._req(spec)

    class WabaResource(Resource):
    """Operations on the WhatsApp Business Account node."""

    def get(self, *, fields: list[str] | str | None = None, waba_id: str | None = None) -> Waba:
        spec = ApiRequest(
            "GET",
            self._waba(waba_id),
            params=clean_params({"fields": merge_fields(fields)}),
            into=Waba.model_validate,
        )
        return self._req(spec)

    def update(
        self, *, name: str | None = None, timezone_id: str | None = None, waba_id: str | None = None
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._req(
            ApiRequest(
                "POST",
                self._waba(waba_id),
                json=clean_body({"name": name, "timezone_id": timezone_id}),
            )
        )

    def analytics(
        self,
        *,
        start: int,
        end: int,
        granularity: str,
        phone_numbers: list[str] | None = None,
        metric_types: list[str] | None = None,
        waba_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Conversation analytics (cost/volume) for the WABA."""
        return self._req(
            ApiRequest(
                "GET",
                self._waba(waba_id),
                params={
                    "fields": _analytics_fields(
                        start=start,
                        end=end,
                        granularity=granularity,
                        phone_numbers=phone_numbers,
                        metric_types=metric_types,
                    )
                },
            )
        )

    def template_analytics(
        self,
        *,
        start: int,
        end: int,
        granularity: str,
        template_ids: list[str] | None = None,
        waba_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Per-template send/deliver/read/click metrics."""
        expr = "template_analytics." + ".".join(
            [f"start({start})", f"end({end})", f"granularity({granularity})"]
            + (["template_ids[" + ",".join(template_ids) + "]"] if template_ids else [])
        )
        return self._req(ApiRequest("GET", self._waba(waba_id), params={"fields": expr}))

    def activities(
        self,
        *,
        fields: list[str] | str | None = None,
        limit: int | None = None,
        after: str | None = None,
        before: str | None = None,
        waba_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> Any:
        spec = ApiRequest(
            "GET",
            f"{self._waba(waba_id)}/activities",
            params=clean_params(
                dict(fields=merge_fields(fields), limit=limit, after=after, before=before)
            ),
        )
        return self._page(spec, Activity.model_validate)

    # --- schedules (template campaigns) --------------------------------------

    def list_schedules(
        self,
        *,
        fields: list[str] | str | None = None,
        limit: int | None = None,
        after: str | None = None,
        before: str | None = None,
        waba_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> Any:
        spec = ApiRequest(
            "GET",
            f"{self._waba(waba_id)}/schedules",
            params=clean_params(
                dict(fields=merge_fields(fields), limit=limit, after=after, before=before)
            ),
        )
        return self._page(spec, Schedule.model_validate)

    def create_schedule(
        self,
        *,
        hsm_id: str,
        delivery_time: int,
        audience_id: str | None = None,
        waba_cs_id: str | None = None,
        name: str | None = None,
        description: str | None = None,
        waba_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        body = clean_body(
            dict(
                hsm_id=hsm_id,
                delivery_time=delivery_time,
                audience_id=audience_id,
                waba_cs_id=waba_cs_id,
                name=name,
                description=description,
            )
        )
        return self._req(ApiRequest("POST", f"{self._waba(waba_id)}/schedules", json=body))

    # --- webhook app subscription ---------------------------------------------

    def subscribed_apps(self, *, waba_id: str | None = None) -> list[SubscribedApp]:
        body = self._req(ApiRequest("GET", f"{self._waba(waba_id)}/subscribed_apps"))
        return [SubscribedApp.model_validate(a) for a in body.get("data") or []]

    def subscribe_app(
        self,
        *,
        override_callback_uri: str | None = None,
        verify_token: str | None = None,
        waba_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Subscribe the calling app to this WABA's webhooks (optionally
        overriding the app's default callback URL)."""
        body = clean_body(
            dict(override_callback_uri=override_callback_uri, verify_token=verify_token)
        )
        return self._req(ApiRequest("POST", f"{self._waba(waba_id)}/subscribed_apps", json=body))

    def unsubscribe_app(self, *, waba_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._req(ApiRequest("DELETE", f"{self._waba(waba_id)}/subscribed_apps"))

    return self._req(ApiRequest("POST", f"{self._waba(waba_id)}/subscribed_apps", json=body))

    @dataclass
class ApiRequest(Generic[T]):
    """A single Graph API call to execute.

    ``into`` optionally decodes the JSON body into a typed result.
    ``raw=True`` returns the :class:`httpx.Response` untouched (downloads).
    """

    method: str
    path: str  # path after "/{version}/", e.g. "{Phone-Number-ID}/messages"
    params: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    json: Any = None
    data: dict[str, Any] | None = None  # form fields (multipart)
    files: dict[str, Any] | None = None  # multipart files
    headers: dict[str, str] | None = None
    absolute: bool = False  # path is a full URL (media download / OAuth)
    into: Decoder[T] | None = None
    raw: bool = False

    class AsyncResource:
    """Async resource bound to an :class:`wapi.AsyncClient`."""

    def __init__(self, client: AsyncClient) -> None:
        self._c = client

    async def _req(self, spec: ApiRequest[T]) -> T:
        return await self._c._execute(spec)

    def _page(self, spec: ApiRequest[Any], decode: Any) -> Any:
        return self._c._cursor(spec, decode)

    def _pnid(self, phone_number_id: str | None) -> str:
        value = phone_number_id or self._c.phone_number_id
        if not value:
            raise ValueError("phone_number_id required — pass it here or to the Client constructor")
        return value

    def _waba(self, waba_id: str | None) -> str:
        value = waba_id or self._c.waba_id
        if not value:
            raise ValueError("waba_id required — pass it here or to the Client constructor")
        return value

    class Resource:
    """Sync resource bound to a :class:`wapi.Client`."""

    def __init__(self, client: Client) -> None:
        self._c = client

    def _req(self, spec: ApiRequest[T]) -> T:
        return self._c._execute(spec)

    def _page(
        self,
        spec: ApiRequest[Any],
        decode: Any,
    ) -> Any:
        return self._c._cursor(spec, decode)

    def _pnid(self, phone_number_id: str | None) -> str:
        value = phone_number_id or self._c.phone_number_id
        if not value:
            raise ValueError("phone_number_id required — pass it here or to the Client constructor")
        return value

    def _waba(self, waba_id: str | None) -> str:
        value = waba_id or self._c.waba_id
        if not value:
            raise ValueError("waba_id required — pass it here or to the Client constructor")
        return value

    class QRCodes(Resource):
    """``/{phone-number-id}/message_qrdls`` — QR codes & message links."""

    def list(
        self,
        *,
        fields: Sequence[str] | str | None = None,
        code: str | None = None,
        limit: int | None = None,
        after: str | None = None,
        before: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> Any:
        spec = ApiRequest(
            "GET",
            f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/message_qrdls",
            params=clean_params(
                dict(
                    fields=merge_fields(fields), code=code, limit=limit, after=after, before=before
                )
            ),
        )
        return self._page(spec, QRCode.model_validate)

    def get(
        self,
        qr_code_id: str,
        *,
        fields: Sequence[str] | str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> QRCode:
        spec = ApiRequest(
            "GET",
            f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/message_qrdls/{qr_code_id}",
            params=clean_params({"fields": merge_fields(fields)}),
        )
        body = self._req(spec)
        data = body.get("data") or [{}]
        return QRCode.model_validate(data[0] if data else {})

    def create_or_update(
        self,
        *,
        prefilled_message: str,
        code: str | None = None,
        generate_qr_image: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Create a QR code (or update it when ``code`` is given).
        ``generate_qr_image``: ``"PNG"`` or ``"SVG"`` to get ``qr_image_url``."""
        body = clean_body(
            dict(
                prefilled_message=prefilled_message, code=code, generate_qr_image=generate_qr_image
            )
        )
        return self._req(
            ApiRequest("POST", f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/message_qrdls", json=body)
        )

    def delete(self, qr_code_id: str, *, phone_number_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._req(
            ApiRequest("DELETE", f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/message_qrdls/{qr_code_id}")
        )

    class BlockedUsers(Resource):
    """``/{phone-number-id}/block_users``."""

    def list(self, *, phone_number_id: str | None = None) -> Sequence[BlockedUser]:
        body = self._req(ApiRequest("GET", f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/block_users"))
        return [BlockedUser.model_validate(u) for u in body.get("users") or []]

    def _set(
        self, method: str, users: Sequence[str], phone_number_id: str | None
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        body = {
            "messaging_product": "whatsapp",
            "block_users": [{"user": u} for u in users],
        }
        return self._req(
            ApiRequest(method, f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/block_users", json=body)
        )

    def block(
        self, users: Sequence[str] | str, *, phone_number_id: str | None = None
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        users = [users] if isinstance(users, str) else users
        return self._set("POST", users, phone_number_id)

    def unblock(
        self, users: Sequence[str] | str, *, phone_number_id: str | None = None
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        users = [users] if isinstance(users, str) else users
        return self._set("DELETE", users, phone_number_id)

    class AsyncQRCodes(AsyncResource):
    def list(
        self,
        *,
        fields: Sequence[str] | str | None = None,
        code: str | None = None,
        limit: int | None = None,
        after: str | None = None,
        before: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> Any:
        spec = ApiRequest(
            "GET",
            f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/message_qrdls",
            params=clean_params(
                dict(
                    fields=merge_fields(fields), code=code, limit=limit, after=after, before=before
                )
            ),
        )
        return self._page(spec, QRCode.model_validate)

    async def get(
        self,
        qr_code_id: str,
        *,
        fields: Sequence[str] | str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> QRCode:
        body = await self._req(
            ApiRequest(
                "GET",
                f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/message_qrdls/{qr_code_id}",
                params=clean_params({"fields": merge_fields(fields)}),
            )
        )
        data = body.get("data") or [{}]
        return QRCode.model_validate(data[0] if data else {})

    async def create_or_update(
        self,
        *,
        prefilled_message: str,
        code: str | None = None,
        generate_qr_image: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        body = clean_body(
            dict(
                prefilled_message=prefilled_message, code=code, generate_qr_image=generate_qr_image
            )
        )
        return await self._req(
            ApiRequest("POST", f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/message_qrdls", json=body)
        )

    async def delete(
        self, qr_code_id: str, *, phone_number_id: str | None = None
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return await self._req(
            ApiRequest("DELETE", f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/message_qrdls/{qr_code_id}")
        )

    class AsyncBlockedUsers(AsyncResource):
    async def list(self, *, phone_number_id: str | None = None) -> Sequence[BlockedUser]:
        body = await self._req(ApiRequest("GET", f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/block_users"))
        return [BlockedUser.model_validate(u) for u in body.get("users") or []]

    async def _set(
        self, method: str, users: Sequence[str], phone_number_id: str | None
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        body = {"messaging_product": "whatsapp", "block_users": [{"user": u} for u in users]}
        return await self._req(
            ApiRequest(method, f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/block_users", json=body)
        )

    async def block(
        self, users: Sequence[str] | str, *, phone_number_id: str | None = None
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        users = [users] if isinstance(users, str) else users
        return await self._set("POST", users, phone_number_id)

    async def unblock(
        self, users: Sequence[str] | str, *, phone_number_id: str | None = None
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        users = [users] if isinstance(users, str) else users
        return await self._set("DELETE", users, phone_number_id)

    def clean_body(body: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Recursively drop ``None`` values from a JSON body."""
    out: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for key, value in body.items():
        if value is None:
            continue
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            out[key] = clean_body(value)
        elif isinstance(value, list):
            out[key] = [clean_body(v) if isinstance(v, dict) else v for v in value]
        else:
            out[key] = value
    return out

    def clean_params(params: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Drop ``None`` values and JSON-encode containers for query params."""
    if not params:
        return None
    return {k: dump_json_field(v) for k, v in params.items() if v is not None}

    def merge_fields(fields: Sequence[str] | str | None) -> str | None:
    if fields is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(fields, str):
        return fields
    return ",".join(fields)
